title: Hepatic Involvement across the Metabolic Syndrome Spectrum: Non-Invasive Assessment and Risk Prediction Using Machine Learning.
summary: Two-step clustering and a CART tree stratified 217 suspected-MASLD patients by transient-elastography-defined liver involvement and selected patients likely to benefit from further evaluation. CART classified cluster membership at 89.4% accuracy; this exploratory small-cohort result is not a validated clinical diagnosis. AI role: Two-step clustering and CART classification. The article appeared in Journal Of Clinical Medicine.
